rows.text: The company expects fourth quarter 2026 revenue to be in the range of $55 million to $75 million and fourth quarter 2026 income per share to be in the range of $0.00 to $0.25.
The company expects full year 2026 revenue to be in the range of $280 million to $300 million and full year 2026 loss per share to range from $1.80 to $2.05.
For the full year 2026, on a non-GAAP basis, we expect loss per share between $0.45 and $0.70.
